integrity: The proof is symbolic and uses the exact occupancy formula from the source plus a polynomial-basis argument. Finite exact-arithmetic checks are only consistency tests and are not used to infer the all-parameter statement.
limitations: The theorem settles only the extreme-point assertion for the convex hull generated by uniform occupancy laws. It does not prove the stronger characterization of all distinct-count laws arising from infinite exchangeable sequences. An equivalent convex-geometric proof could exist under different occupancy or Stirling-curve terminology, although targeted searches found none and the current motivating text still states the assertion as a conjecture.
title: Every uniform occupancy law is exposed in the distinct-count convex hull
